result:
QA-29122 is a PASS. I ran all three Monday pairs from the Description table, and all six channel legs passed. Every post satisfies Reactions + Comments + Shares = Engagements, and the column totals match the Sum row in each case.

| Pair | Twitter | Instagram |
|---|---|---|
| HBO Max / HBO Max | 14/14 posts | 40/40 posts |
| Amazon Prime Video / Amazon Prime Video | 71/71 posts | 68/68 posts |
| Condé Nast / Vogue - US | 171/171 posts | 51/51 posts |

- **Names on dev:** the spec's "Conde Nast" is "Condé Nast" (accented) and "Vogue-US" is "Vogue - US". Both are the only matches, so no substitution.
- **Hang:** one combined script hung for about 31 minutes, so I re-ran the pairs stepwise with timeouts. The cause was the shared account-switch helper failing to match the accented name, not a product defect. I'd fix the helper to ignore accents, but I didn't touch it because skill and helper maintenance is deferred to harvest.sh.
- **Case notes:** the case's Notes rotation line disagrees with its Description table (Monday). I followed the table.
- **Open bugs:** no linked bugs were open, so nothing was filed.

The report is at `results/2026-10-26/QA-29122-report.md`, with screenshots in `.playwright-out/QA-29122/`.
